name: What are common mistakes to avoid when implementing AEO for plastic surgeons?
description: Avoid overly promotional content, vague answers, keyword stuffing, poor formatting, and not updating content or monitoring competitors for effective AEO.

mainEntity.name: What are common mistakes to avoid when implementing AEO for plastic surgeons?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common mistakes to avoid when implementing AEO for plastic surgeons include creating overly promotional or sales-oriented content instead of purely informational answers. Providing vague or incomplete information that doesn't directly address the user's question is also counterproductive. Overstuffing keywords, neglecting clear formatting (like headings and lists), and failing to regularly update content are other pitfalls. Additionally, not monitoring competitors' featured snippets and not adapting content based on search engine updates can hinder AEO success. Focus on clarity, conciseness, and user intent over self-promotion.
